metadata.title: Factorial runs its incentive plans and shareholder register with Sttok
metadata.description: Factorial uses Sttok to manage its incentive plans, as well as its shareholder register, general meetings and corporate documents.
metadata.keywords: Factorial, Sttok, shareholder register, incentive plans, Sttok customers

summary.title: Factorial runs its shareholder register and incentive plans with Sttok

quote.text: Sttok has helped us digitise the creation, signing and tracking of beneficiaries across all our incentive plan documents, as well as managing the shareholder register (cap table).
quote.author: Lucía Bouzá

features.value: Shareholder register, incentive plans, document generation and e-signature

sections.title: About Factorial
texts: Factorial is a human resources management software company, aimed mainly at small and medium-sized businesses.

sections.title: Why they chose Sttok
texts: 1. Ease of use of the platform.

uses.title: Letters come straight from the plan
uses.text: Each new hire gets their invitation letter and signs it, with no Word files or emails.

uses.title: Each employee sees their own
uses.text: Their units, their schedule and their value, in their portal.

uses.title: The shareholder register, in the same place
uses.text: Shareholders and incentive plan, always reconciled.
